meta.titleMagicCube: Magic cube online — turn and solve a 3×3 cube in 3D — cv.cm
meta.descMagicCube: Play a magic cube online in 3D: scramble a 2×2, 3×3 or 4×4 cube, turn layers by dragging or with the keyboard, and time your solve. Free, works on phones.

magic-cube.name: Magic cube
magic-cube.blurb: Scramble a 3D cube and solve it against the clock.

magic-cube.q1: How do I turn a layer?
magic-cube.a1: Press Play, then drag a sticker in the direction you want its row or column to move. Drag anywhere off the cube to look around it. On a keyboard, U D L R F B turn the outer faces and Shift turns them the other way.
magic-cube.a2: Each letter is a face: U up, D down, L left, R right, F front, B back. A letter alone is a quarter turn clockwise as you look at that face, an apostrophe (R') is anticlockwise, and a 2 (R2) is a half turn.
magic-cube.a3: Layer by layer. Make a cross on one face with the edge colours matching the centres, put the four corners of that face in, then the middle-layer edges. Finally solve the last face: form its cross, orient its corners, and move the corners and edges into place.
magic-cube.a4: 2×2, 3×3 and 4×4. The 2×2 is only corners, so it is a good warm-up; the 4×4 has no fixed centres, so you pair centres and edges before solving it like a 3×3.
magic-cube.a5: Yes. The scramble, your turns, the clock and your best time for each size are kept in this browser, so you can close the page and carry on later.

magic-cube.lead: Solve a magic cube in three steps.
magic-cube.s1b: Choose a size and press Scramble. The clock starts with your first turn.
magic-cube.s2b: Drag stickers to turn rows and columns, drag the background to look around, or use U D L R F B on the keyboard.
magic-cube.s3b: When every face is one colour the clock stops and your best time is kept.
